data.description: Dallas-Fort Worth young-worker labor organizing group. Its public Action Network page says YALL DFW was established in 2014 as part of the Dallas AFL-CIO's local effort to educate young people about the labor movement and empower worker advocacy. The exact name resolves the ambiguous 'young active labor leaders' wording in the Forward Observer source context.
